meta.description: Every-2-days auto-poster to Instagram (2-step container->poll->publish) and Facebook Page. Credentials from env via the bedrock-broadcaster-meta ExternalSecret. NON-DUPLICATING: a date-derived sequence (advances every 2 days, no persisted state) cycles every post through a different image AND a unique hook+body caption combo (6 images x 3 hooks x 3 bodies = 54 unique posts before any exact repeat), with layered/rotating hashtags. FB /photos requires the Page to have completed Meta identity confirmation.
